$comment: Per-provider catalog revision handling and what gets reported (complements metadata_payload.v2.cases.json revisionCases, which only cover the index path). Same rules on the catalog path as on the index path: a cache without a revision (0 = bundled snapshot or schema 1) accepts any response body, including revision 0; a lower revision than the cached one is refused and reported once as revision_regressed; an equal revision is 'unchanged' (keep data, refresh ETag atomically - also when the revision then turns out to differ from the index; expect.etag = 'refreshed'). When the index already announces the cached revision, no catalog request is sent at all (not even a conditional one), so nothing can be refreshed: expect.requestSent = false, expect.etag = 'unchanged'; tests must announce the revision truthfully instead of hiding it from the index or faking the stored revision to force a request. If the unchanged catalog's revision still differs from what the index announced, refetch the index once; if they still differ, report once as revision_mismatch (one report per provider per sync, never catalog_revision). Each end names its tests CATALOG_REVISION_REPORT_<id> (Web: it('CATALOG-REVISION-REPORT-<id> ...')).
